notes: LTX-2.3 distilled two-stage image-to-video: base8 fixed Euler sigmas, native latent upscaler2x, original first-frame anchoring at strength1, then3 fixed refinement steps (sigmas0.85,0.725,0.4219,0; CFG1). Silent output has twice the base width and height. Both samplers reuse the caller seed and sampler; base CFG remains caller-controlled. Needs ltx-2.3-spatial-upscaler-x2-1.1.safetensors in a native latent_upscale_models path. Optional detail refinement, not a guarantee of identity, anatomy or camera quality. Adapted from the MIT Comfy-Org LTX2.3 I2V workflow; weights use the LTX-2 Community License.
